title: Cinema policy, institutions and new screens
description: Filmada's earlier chronology records the adoption of a national policy for cinema and animated images in 2017, cooperation between OMACI and the Rencontres du Film Court, and the opening of Plaza, Cinépax and CanalOlympia screens. It also records the 2019 repeal of the policy and suppression of OMACI. This institutional sequence requires careful legal and documentary sourcing.

sources.note: Recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; legislation and institutional changes require official citations.
